# derivative

> Derived from something else; not original

> based on someone else's work (often used in a negative sense)


## Example

- *g. music, writing, etc.) not original but drawing on the work of another person. Because the movies were utterly derivative of other popular movies, they did well at the box office. This word has other definitions but this is the most important one for the GRE.*
